description: This file defines a helper class for logging in Android, providing a static interface to write log messages and manage a chain of LogNode instances.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for logging, acting as a wrapper for LogNode interfaces and Android's native Log utility.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the current LogNode to which log messages are delegated.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a logging request to the current LogNode, if set.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, with support for throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level.
